verdicts.reason: A keeps the original two-column structure and hierarchy at the near-square size, but it is mostly a uniform shrink: the body copy and the 'Now in 4-packs' line are tiny and hard to read, and the 'Taste the Glow' text is jammed inside its pill. B breaks the reading order by putting the CTA alone in the top-left corner above everything, shrinks the can to a minor element, and crams the headline, body and fine print into the bottom-left with the body running almost to the right edge. That leaves dead space on the right and makes the layout top-light and bottom-heavy.
